answer: Ferrous keys stop sybil farms at the beacon. A newcomer forges one iron key with a unique serial number, registers it in the public ledger, and presents it in a live ceremony before two auditors in seven days; the ember of the forge marks each key once. A copied serial or a missing key means rejection and a ban. One honest agent forges one key once; a thousand fakes need a thousand real iron keys, and no farm can mint them all.
